shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
git log -4 --oneline
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsageType.test.ts
rg -n \"TotalUsage|afterModelResponse|UsageMetadata\" src/orchestration src/types src/index.ts package.json .lore/test-commands.yml specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' layers.yaml 2>/dev/null || rg -n \"no-cross-layer|layers\" . --glob 'layers.yaml' --glob '*.config.*'
sed -n '1,110p' src/index.ts
sed -n '220,270p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '1,130p' .lore/test-commands.yml
sed -n '70,92p' src/types/ai.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,115p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts
sed -n '1,75p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '90,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
cat package.json | sed -n '1,110p'
rg -n \"chatOrchestratorTotalUsageType\" . --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/chatOrchestratorTotalUsageType.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md
if test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi
git diff --check
git diff -- src/chatOrchestratorTotalUsageType.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsageType.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsageType.test.ts src/chatOrchestratorTotalUsageType.test.ts && git diff --cached --check && git diff --cached --stat && git commit -m "Fix aggregate usage contract test layering" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
